Common questions

What areas do you serve?

We serve Utah County and Salt Lake County, Utah — including Provo and Orem and surrounding communities in both counties. If you're in Utah County or Salt Lake County, we come to you. Not sure if you're in our area? Call us at (435) 592-9333 and we'll let you know.

Do I need to be home during the cleaning?

Not at all. Most customers give us a key, code, or garage access and come home to a clean house. Every cleaner is background-checked and insured, and we’ll lock up and message you when we leave.

Do you bring your own supplies and equipment?

Yes — vacuums, mops, and eco-friendly cleaning products are all included in the price. If you prefer specific products used in your home, leave them out and we’ll happily use those instead.

What if I need to reschedule?

Life happens. Reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before your appointment — just reply to your confirmation text or email.

Are you okay with pets?

We love them. Just let us know who’ll be home so we can say hello properly (and keep doors secure). Our products are pet-safe, and the pet-hair add-on is great for heavy shedding seasons.

How does the happiness guarantee work?

If anything doesn’t meet the checklist standard, tell us within 24 hours and we’ll come back and re-clean that area free. If we still can’t make it right, we’ll refund that portion of the visit.
